# AMEVA-Core Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
High-Performance Edge & Browser Native Open-Source Systems Library
Eliminates server roundtrips by compiling low-level kernels directly to WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 with zero-leak buffer pooling and closed-form mathematical precision.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: ameva-core
- Command: pip install ameva-core
# or: npm install @ameva/core
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/uno-km

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Zero-Config Native Execution**: Executes instantly on mobile, Termux, and browser runtimes with zero external compilation overhead.
- **Mathematical Integrity & Precision**: Closed-form algebraic formulation with deterministic float precision across heterogeneous hardware.
- **Hardware Memory Protection**: Automated buffer pooling and weakref lifetime management preventing GPU VRAM exhaustion.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
import ameva_core as ac
engine = ac.Engine()
print(engine.compute([1.0, 2.0]))
```
